title: 第1724章奉旨卖题长安的帮会简直太不讲礼貌了第1723章活阎王其实压力也挺大的都吃素了
slug: 我最强毒士女帝直呼活阎王
lines: 城西。
天字号客栈后门。
王腾和王世安一前一后拎着包袱，悄悄从后门溜了出来。
王腾的脸色难看。
王世安的脸色更是难看。
父子二人一出门，连灯笼都不敢靠近，贴着墙根便往巷口走。
王腾压低声音道：“爹，咱们真要走？”
王世安没好气地道：“不走干什么？你还嫌这次不够丢人？”
王腾咬了咬牙。
“可我不甘心啊。”
“这次实在太丢人了，爹在长安为我造了那么大的势，甚至连赌场都有人押我能中前三。”
“结果呢？”
“真题一道没中，废题倒是买了一堆。”
“孩子在贡院里被高阳折磨得像条狗，现在还要在放榜之前灰溜溜的离开长安，这怎能让我甘心？”
王腾说到这里，那是越想越气。
“最可气的还是那天香赌坊的朱三！”
“他卖假题！”
“假题啊！”
“长安的帮会简直太不讲礼貌了，做生意哪有这么做的？”
王世安脚步一顿，低声呵斥。
“闭嘴！”
“现在是说这些的时候吗？”
“人家卖了假题，现在直接开溜，你上哪找他去？还能报官不成？”
王腾后槽牙都快咬疼了。
这怎么报官？
说自己科举舞弊被坑了一万两的银子？你帮我找到那个不讲武德的混蛋，将他关起来？
“罢了罢了！”
“今夜换个客栈，咱父子俩明日就出城吧，离开这个伤心地。”
“至于一万两的银子……权当买个教训吧，爹总觉得有股不妙的感觉，反正考不上，不如早点开溜。”王世安声音低沉的道。
父子二人换了一身破袍子，就像是乞丐一般，蜷缩在巷角，皆是心情沉重。
与此同时。
客栈正门外。
张寿带着朱三和几名锦衣卫到了。
张寿抬头看了一眼二楼。
“王腾就住这？”
content_en:
West of the city.
The back door of Tianzihao Inn.
Wang Teng and Wang Shi'an carried their luggage one after the other and slipped out of the back door quietly.
Wang Teng's face looked ugly.
Wang Shian's face was even more ugly.
As soon as the father and son went out, they didn't even dare to get close to the lantern, and walked toward the entrance of the alley close to the wall.
Wang Teng lowered his voice and said, "Dad, do we really want to leave?"
Wang Shian said angrily: "Why don't you leave? Do you think this time is not embarrassing enough?"
Wang Teng gritted his teeth.
"But I'm not willing to do it."
"It's really embarrassing this time. Dad created such a big momentum for me in Chang'an. There were even people in the casino betting that I would be among the top three."
"What's the result?"
"I didn't get one of the real questions, but I bought a bunch of useless questions."
"The child was tortured like a dog by Gao Yang in the Gongyuan, and now he has to leave Chang'an in despair before the results are released. How can I be willing to do this?"
When Wang Teng said this, he became more and more angry as he thought about it.
"The most irritating thing is Zhu San from Tianxiang Gambling House!"
"He sells fake questions!"
"False question!"
"The gangs in Chang'an are so rude. How can you do this in business?"
Wang Shian paused and scolded in a low voice.
"Shut up!"
"Is now the time to talk about this?"
"He sold a fake question and now he's running away. Where can you find him? Can you still report him to the official?"
Wang Teng’s molars almost hurt from biting them.
How do you report this to the official?
Saying that he cheated in the imperial examination and was defrauded of 10,000 taels of silver? Can you help me find that ungrateful bastard and lock him up?
"That's all!"
"We'll change to an inn tonight, and we, father and son, will leave the city tomorrow and leave this sad place."
"As for the ten thousand taels of silver... let's just teach him a lesson. Dad always feels something bad. He won't pass the exam anyway, so it's better to run away as soon as possible." Wang Shi'an said in a low voice.
The father and son changed into tattered robes, like beggars, huddled in the corner of the alley, both with heavy hearts.
at the same time.
Outside the main entrance of the inn.
Zhang Shou arrived with Zhu San and several Jinyi guards.
Zhang Shou raised his head and glanced at the second floor.
"Wang Teng lives here?"
title_en: Chapter 1724: The gang in Chang'an who was ordered to sell issues was simply too rude. Chapter 1723: The Living King of Hell was actually under so much pressure that he became a vegetarian.
